content: For explicit evaluation of the generalized language perspective of the distilled student language models, we use the Reddit dataset BIBREF40 to measure word mask prediction accuracy of the student models, since the language used on Reddit is different from that in the training corpora. The dataset is preprocessed similarly to the training corpora, except we do not need to tokenize it using the teacher vocabulary, since we only run and evaluate the student models.
